title: Item 17b · Typing that a stray Esc throws away
subtitle: Approved rule, a few gaps (drift; one planned). The rule (v0.46): if someone has typed and presses Esc, clicks outside or goes back, the dialog stays open with “Unsaved changes. Save or cancel first.” — nothing typed is silently lost (phones add a “Discard changes” link, v0.56). Most dialogs follow it. Gaps found and tested in the preview: Forms' Fill in and New form close on a second Esc and the answers are gone — although Fill in's own note says “press Cancel to throw it away”; Camps' Save as template closes on the first Esc; Prospects' Edit statuses drops a changed status with no note; Change PIN / Change password close on Esc (aligning them was planned in v0.56, “to be aligned later with Jeffrey's OK”). On purpose: Finance's Close the day keeps a draft instead (v0.800); Black Belt's rubric editor has its own leave rule (v0.928). No guard needed: Prospects' one-click dialogs (Book a time, Joined, Came?) hold nothing typed. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.label: Today

row.caption: 1. The rule working (Color Belt's Edit details after two Escs): the dialog stays open with the amber note.
2. Forms' Fill in after one Esc: “This sign-up isn't sent yet. Send it or press Cancel to throw it away.”

items.caption: 3. …a second Esc closes it: the family's answers are gone, and reopening shows an empty form. New form does the same.

row.caption: 4. Camps' Save as template with a typed name…
5. …one Esc closes it and the name is lost.

columns.note: Also: Prospects' Edit statuses drops a changed status on Esc (no note); Change PIN / Change password close on Esc. Seen in passing: Fill in's note sits above its buttons, not under them as v0.81 says.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · the guard everywhere

row.caption: 6. Camps' Save as template stays open with the shared note.
7. Forms' Fill in and New form: the note stays after any number of Escs, until Send / Save or Cancel.

columns.note: What changes where: Forms — Fill in and New form ignore a second Esc (phones keep the “Discard changes” link). Camps — Save as template gets the note. Prospects — Edit statuses gets the note. Main — Change PIN / Change password join the rule (the v0.56 alignment). Recorded exceptions: Finance's Close the day draft (v0.800), Black Belt's rubric editor (v0.928), one-click dialogs. Picture 6 is drawn over the real dialog; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: should the unsaved-changes guard hold everywhere?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − a double Esc wipes a family's sign-up typed at the desk; three more dialogs lose typing without a word.
B · Recommended: close every gap (pictures 6–7). Forms' Fill in and New form keep their note until Send / Save or Cancel; Camps' Save as template and Prospects' Edit statuses get the shared note; Change PIN / Change password join the rule (the alignment planned in v0.56 — this would be your OK). + nothing typed is ever lost to a stray key; one behaviour in every dialog. − small changes in Forms, Camps, Prospects and the account dialogs.
C · Only where whole forms are typed: Forms' Fill in and New form, and Prospects' Edit statuses. + least work for the biggest risk. − Camps' template name and the PIN / password dialogs still lose typing on Esc.
